description:
Draft, not released. Stations get levels. A level widens the catchment area, raises the waiting capacity, or cuts pollution, noise or upkeep. You buy each level in the station's window.

Source and notes: https://github.com/WuphonsReach/tf3-station-retrofits (MIT licence).
name: Station Retrofits
summary: Stations get levels for a wider catchment area, more waiting capacity, less pollution and noise, and lower upkeep.
